items: Objective: Enhance the standard of living for senior citizens (14.3 crore by 2021).
o Revamped National Action Plan for Senior Citizens
o Support to States, UTs, NGOs, and Local Bodies
o Essential Services: Shelter, food, healthcare
 Vayoshri Yojana: Assisted living devices for elderly
Ensures improved quality of life, healthcare, and support for senior citizens.
